summary: GigCapital8 Corp., a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed an 8-K disclosing an Agreement and Plan of Merger dated October 8, 2026, with Quantisimo Corp. (BVI) and its shareholders WISeQey Corp and SealSQ Corp. The structure uses a new BVI holding company, Quantisimo Holdings Corp. (PubCo), with Target Merger Sub and SPAC Merger Sub effecting a dual merger that takes the SPAC public vehicle into the operating target. A joint press release followed October 9 as Exhibit 99.1; no price, stake, premium, or board recommendation appears in the excerpt. Watch the F-4/proxy timeline, redemption levels, and PIPE or financing terms.
